name: limit-compact
description: Compacts a large session at the very end of the account's 5-hour or weekly limit, while its prompt cache is warm, so the next account has little to load.

triggerPercent.title: Compact at usage (%)
triggerPercent.description: Compact when the account's 5-hour or weekly window reaches this much. Compacting needs a little quota, so a value too close to 100 may fail (then nothing is lost: the next account just reads everything).

instructions.title: What the summary must keep
instructions.description: Passed to the compaction: what the summary should keep or stress.
instructions.default: Keep the current task and its status, decisions made and why, open files and exact paths, commands and their results that still matter, and what to do next.

minContextPercent.title: Only when the context is at least (% of the window)
minContextPercent.description: Sessions with less than this are cheap to load on another account and are left alone.
